# XM15_replogle_val: retrieval metrics with 95% bootstrap CIs

Cache `/vol/data/replogle_k562_essential_gears_simulation_seed1`; experiments replogle_k562_v1. n_test = 31 held-out genes (chance id_top1 = 0.032, chance id_mean_rank = 16.0); 278 reference (training) perturbations; 500 genes.
Per-gene scores averaged over seeds, then paired bootstrap over test genes (2000 resamples, rng seed 0, percentile CIs). cluster_agreement recomputed on each resampled sub-matrix (duplicate-gene pairs dropped; undefined draws skipped).
**Small n caveat:** with only 31 test genes the CIs are wide; they cover resampling of these genes only (not other gene sets / datasets), and seed variation enters only through the seed average (1/2/5 seed(s) per deep arm). NaN per-seed scores (constant predictions) are skipped in the seed average.
